deleted_because: Publicly invokable (roles/run.invoker granted to allUsers) while running as klaus-runtime, the SAME service account as production, against the SAME Firestore database (klaus-firestore) with the same Secret Manager access. An unmaintained second front door to live data.
Zero requests in the preceding 90 days of Cloud Logging.
None of the 10 Cloud Scheduler jobs targeted it; all point at the me-west1 URL.
No reference to the europe-west1 URL anywhere in the repo.
Still on revision 00002, created 2026-05-16 by a manual `gcloud run deploy --source`, never updated by CI (deploy.yml deploys me-west1 only).
Did not even serve: GET /health and GET / both returned 500.
Its own CLOUD_RUN_URL env var pointed at the me-west1 service.
not_the_reason: Cost. It had no minScale, so it scaled to zero and billed ~nothing. This was removed as attack surface, not as spend.
